\caption{MovieLens-25M fixed-horizon Thompson Sampling experiments up to $T=25{,}000{,}000$ over ten repeats. Panel (a) reports native attack costs for our two offline constructions and the bounded heuristic of \citet{zuo2024near}; the dashed curve is a scaled $S_T=T^{2/3}(K\log T)^{1/3}$ bound chosen to upper-bound the displayed mean-plus-standard-deviation envelope of our costs. Panel (b) reports total target-arm exposure $N_K/T$ and, for our attacks, post-deployment success $N_K^{\on}/H$. \citet{xu2021observation} is omitted because its observation-free cost dominates the displayed scale.}
